ev.debt_creditors.title: Creditors at the door
ev.debt_creditors.text: The people you owe will not wait any longer. They stand at your door, counting aloud how much interest has piled up.
ev.debt_creditors.sell.ok: The chest, your best clothes and the dishes are gone. The debt is smaller, and the house emptier.
ev.debt_creditors.work_off.ok: For a year you worked for the creditor from dawn to dusk. Your back aches, but part of the debt is gone.
ev.debt_creditors.family.success: Your family grumbled, but scraped the money together. Shameful - yet easier to breathe.
ev.debt_creditors.family.failure: Your family had nothing to spare. And now the neighbours know how bad things are.
ev.debt_creditors.hide.success: You stayed with friends for a while, and the creditors backed off for now.
ev.debt_creditors.hide.failure: They found you. The creditor's men were not gentle.
ev.debt_pit.title: The debt pit
ev.debt_pit.text: The debt has grown beyond anything your work can repay: the interest eats more than you bring home. The creditors want a decision - now.
ev.debt_pit.bondage.ok: You bound yourself to work off the debt. Less freedom - but no more knocking at the door.
ev.debt_pit.sell_all.ok: Almost everything is gone. You will start from nothing - but without the noose around your neck.
ev.debt_pit.patron.ok: A wealthy neighbour bought up your debt. Now you owe him - and he will not let you forget it.
ev.debt_pit.flee.ok: You left at night, leaving the debts behind. Nobody knows you here - and for now, that is good.
ev.debt_gambling_night.title: A night of dice
ev.debt_gambling_night.text: At first you were lucky. Then the stakes grew, the wine flowed, and by morning you had lost more than you earn in two years.
ev.debt_gambling_night.pay.ok: You paid to the last coin. Nobody at home spoke to you for a long time.
ev.debt_gambling_night.owe.ok: The winner wrote down the debt and smiled: "I can wait. With interest."
ev.debt_gambling_night.refuse.success: You walked away without paying. No fight - but the rumour spread fast.
ev.debt_gambling_night.refuse.failure: They did not like the refusal. You were beaten, and had to pay part of it anyway.
ev.debt_gambling_due.title: The gambling debt falls due
ev.debt_gambling_due.text: The man you lost to is back - with two sturdy lads and a paper on which the debt has doubled.
ev.debt_gambling_due.pay.ok: You gave everything you had and borrowed the rest. An expensive lesson.
ev.debt_gambling_due.beg.success: You talked him into taking half. He left unhappy - but he left.
ev.debt_gambling_due.beg.failure: Talking did not help. There were threats, then blows - and he took everything.
ev.debt_gambling_due.flee.ok: You fled to another land. The debt stayed where you no longer are.
ev.debt_child_gambling.title: Your child's debt
ev.debt_child_gambling.text: {npc} came at night, pale: a fortune lost at dice. The creditors want their money - if not from {g=npc_sex:him|her}, then from you.
ev.debt_child_gambling.take.ok: You paid. {npc} wept and swore never again.
ev.debt_child_gambling.half: Pay half and teach a lesson
ev.debt_child_gambling.half.ok: You paid half; {npc} works off the rest. Offended - but maybe it will stick.
ev.debt_child_gambling.leave.ok: "You lost it - you pay it." {npc} left in silence. Your money is safe, but there is a wall between you now.
ev.debt_moneylender.title: The moneylender
ev.debt_moneylender.text: A moneylender from the market has noticed you are struggling. "Take it now, pay me back when you are rich. The interest is small," he says with a gentle smile.
ev.debt_moneylender.take.ok: The purse is heavier. You would rather not think about paying it back with interest.
ev.debt_moneylender.refuse.ok: You said no. Life is tight, but you owe no one.
ev.debt_loan_due.title: The loan falls due
ev.debt_loan_due.text: The moneylender came with his ledger: the time is up, and with interest the debt is much bigger than what you took.
ev.debt_loan_due.repay.ok: You paid every coin. Never again to a moneylender.
ev.debt_loan_due.extend.ok: He agreed - for a fee and fresh interest. The debt has not gone anywhere.
ev.debt_forgiven.text: Your old creditor died, and his heir forgave part of the debts «for the peace of his soul». For the first time in ages you slept soundly.
ev.debt_rich_feast.title: A feast for the neighbourhood
ev.debt_rich_feast.text: People of your standing are expected to give a yearly feast for neighbours, kin and useful people. Everyone is waiting to see how generous it will be.
ev.debt_rich_feast.lavish.ok: The tables groaned, musicians played till dawn. People will talk about it all year - and the bill is not small either.
ev.debt_rich_feast.modest.ok: A decent meal, but no splendour. Someone whispered that you were stingy.
ev.debt_rich_feast.refuse.ok: The money is safe, but the neighbours are offended: that is not how it is done.
